title: Weekends Go Homework-Free: Zero on the Wall | vitalii.no
description:
Our kids' quiz deck had no sense of 'today' — it just rotated through whatever topics were due, mixing in homework as its own separate card seven days a week, Saturday and Sunday included, even though there's no school and no homework to even point at on those days.

I added a 'today' walk mode to LearningBoard that activates Monday through Friday after 12:00 Oslo time, pulling the subjects a child actually had that day and marking the matching tile with an 'I dag' pill. Homework due the next day now rides as a line attached to that subject's own practice card, instead of existing as a separate card to answer. I also fixed an ordering bug where scene-attaching ran before the deck was finalized, which had been silently dropping preview and Ukas ord scenes before they ever reached the TV.

Weekday afternoons now show a kid what he actually studied that day instead of a random rotation, and weekends drop to zero homework items on the wall — exactly the way weekends already work at school.
